questions.stem: Which of the following is a feature of fungi?
choices: They have cell walls made of chitin
questions.solution: Fungi have cell walls made of chitin, which is a defining characteristic of their structure. Unlike plants, fungi cannot perform photosynthesis because they lack chlorophyll. While some fungi are unicellular, many are multicellular, and all fungi are eukaryotic, meaning they have a distinct nucleus.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of fungi?
choices: They cause diseases in plants only
questions.solution: Fungi can reproduce by budding, which is a form of asexual reproduction. This is a common method among certain types of fungi, such as yeast. The other options are incorrect because fungi are not autotrophic, they can be both unicellular and multicellular, and they can cause diseases in both plants and animals.

questions.stem: If a microorganism is unicellular, has a nucleus, and moves using flagella, which kingdom does it belong to?
questions.solution: Protista includes unicellular organisms with a nucleus and structures like flagella for movement. Monera are prokaryotic and lack a nucleus. Fungi are typically multicellular and lack flagella. Plantae are autotrophic and do not move using flagella.

hi.stem: यदि एक जीवाणु एककोशिकीय है, कोशिका झिल्ली रखता है और झिल्ली के उपयोग से गति करता है, तो यह किस जगत में सम्बन्धित होता है?
hi.solution: प्रोटिस्टा में एककोशिकीय जीव होते हैं जिनमें कोशिका झिल्ली होती है और गति के लिए झिल्ली जैसी संरचनाएं होती हैं। मोनेरा प्रोकैरियोटिक होते हैं और कोशिका झिल्ली नहीं रखते। फंजाई आमतौर पर बहुकोशिकीय होते हैं और झिल्ली नहीं रखते। पौधे स्वपोषी होते हैं और झिल्ली के उपयोग से गति नहीं करते।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the scientific terminology used in Hindi textbooks.

questions.stem: Which of the following organisms can be classified as both a protist and a parasite?
questions.solution: Plasmodium is a protist because it is a single-celled eukaryote and a parasite because it relies on a host for survival, causing malaria. Chlorella is an autotrophic organism that produces its own food, Candida is a fungus that reproduces through budding, and Tomato Wilt Virus is a non-living entity that cannot carry out life processes on its own.

questions.stem: A microorganism is found to be a saprophyte and has a cell wall made of chitin. Which kingdom does it belong to?
questions.solution: Fungi are known to be saprophytes and have cell walls made of chitin, which matches the given characteristics. Monera, which includes bacteria, does not have cell walls made of chitin and are not typically saprophytes. Protista and Plantae also lack this specific combination of traits.
